messages:
Mika: heads up — after the eval-runner restart at ~03:40 UTC we're seeing per-sample traces uploaded with the wrong eval_id, which is splitting dashboards and making retention TTL not trigger for many traces.
Devin: ugh, can you paste an example object metadata / put log?
Mika: here are two consecutive puts from the same run that landed with different eval_id headers:
```
PUT s3://redwood-eval-traces/prod/2026-03-18/trace-0a1b.json
x-amz-meta-eval-id: eval-2026-03-18-42
Content-Length: 12KB

PUT s3://redwood-eval-traces/prod/2026-03-18/trace-0a2b.json
x-amz-meta-eval-id: eval-2026-03-17-09
Content-Length: 8KB
```
Mika: same runner, same job id. we think the uploader picked up an env var from a previous process.
Jules: did the runner fork worker procs that inherit OLD_EVAL env? we had one bug where env was set before job metadata refresh.
Samir: retention TTL job groups by eval_id + date. if eval_id is wrong retention job doesn't mark objects for deletion -> storage grows. also dashboard groups by eval_id so metrics get split.
Devin: any KMS errors in ops logs? if manifests lost encryption headers, restore will fail too.
ops-bot: KMS decrypt errors spiking for trace restore: "AccessDeniedException: Failed to decrypt" for 29 objects since 03:45 UTC.
CI-bot: CI integration test `trace-uploader::metadata_consistency` failing on master with a flake that looks related — repro in test-run-87 reproduces eval_id mismatch after simulated restart.
Jules: looks like uploader attaches eval_id from `EVAL_RUN_ID` env if `metadata_cache` is stale. After restart the cache can have previous job id until first heartbeat. race window.
Mika: workaround: redeploy eval-runner with hotfix that clears metadata_cache on process start. but need a proper fix to derive eval_id from job API call, not env.
Samir: also we should add a compact manifest for each upload batch with canonical eval_id and a content-hash index. retention job can prefer manifest eval_id if object headers mismatch.
Devin: agree. action items:
- short: patch uploader to fetch eval_id from job API on first upload (mika)
- medium: update retention job to consult batch manifest if object header != manifest (samir)
- long: add CI test to simulate restart + concurrent uploads (jules)
Mika: posted a minimal reproduction in #eng-ml-playground: reproduce script sets EVAL_RUN_ID then spawns children that upload concurrently, shows env bleed.
Devin: also add a guard: if put-object returns success but headers inconsistent, write a small tombstone manifest and emit metric `trace.uploader.header_mismatch`.
Jules: will follow up with PRs. tagging @devops for KMS ACL review in case some objects were uploaded with wrong encryption headers.
ops-bot: opened ticket INFRA-764: Investigate KMS decrypt spikes and mark potentially corrupted objects.
Samir: estimate impact: ~18k traces since restart window (~2 AM — 5 AM) across 4 customers; storage delta ~1.9GB. not huge but breaks quality dashboards.
Mika: thanks team. I'll push the hotfix now and wire the CI test. please ack on PRs when ready. :thumbsup:
Devin: ack, will monitor retention job run at 06:00 UTC and report back.
Jules: working on tests, will link PRs in thread.
Mika: closing loop once retention job re-runs and KMS error rate drops.
